text:
jess-sales: Hey team — NovusBank asked for a compact assurance bundle for the POC next week. They specifically want: a short pen-test engagement letter (signed or signable template), red-team scope statement (external network + app auth flow, no phishing), and 2–3 ISO27001 control excerpts they can include in their docs. POC kickoff is Mon so we need this by EOD Fri.

sam-security: Got it. We have a standard pen-test letter but it mentions full external+internal. They want red-team only — can confirm whether we can restrict to external + auth flows. Quick Q: do they need proof of remediation windows or just the attestation of the test?

jess-sales: They said "attestation of tests performed" + sample findings redacted. Not full remediation timeline; a short note that critical issues are triaged within our SLA would be fine. Also they asked about impact on Dedicated pricing if we allow onprem network scan windows.

mike-ops: Scans against Dedicated pools need a maintenance window to avoid noisy telemetry; that's a potential 10% charge if we reserve dedicated capacity for scheduled red-team bursts. I can provide the ops blurb for the letter.

tara-legal: For the pen-test letter we need to avoid promising unlimited access. We'll provide a template with scope, allowed targets, data handling clause (no exfil of PII), and signature block for our CISO. Also we should include an attestation line for third-party vendor if they used an external tester.

alex-cto: FYI from infra: we can provide KMS attestation snippet saying customer data at rest is under customer-specific envelope keys in staging. But legal will need the exact wording.

sam-security: I can draft the red-team scope bullet list. Proposed scope: external perimeter (IPs listed), auth endpoints (/api/v1/login, oidc callback), web app logic tests, no social engineering, no physical tests. Sample: 
```
Scope: External network and authentication flow testing only. Targets: 52.14.23.0/24, app.example.com. Excluded: internal networks, employee phishing, physical security.
```

jess-sales: Perfect. Also Novus asked for ISO excerpts: they want controls related to access control, cryptography, and supplier security. Can we provide small snippets (2–3 sentences each) rather than full SoA?

tara-legal: We can produce short ISO‑style excerpts. Example: "A.9 Access Control — Access to production systems is granted via SSO and role-based groups; periodic access review occurs quarterly; privileged access requires justification and ticketing." Keep them generic and not a full SoA.

mike-ops: I'll add an ops note about ephemeral creds for their test: we can provision scoped creds valid 48h and collect logs to a presigned S3. If they need upload, we can give a presigned PUT link. Example command to generate link (internal):
```
aws s3 presign s3://proofpack-uploads/novusbank/scan-output.tgz --expires-in 172800
```

sam-security: @tara-legal can you OK the pen-test template? I can draft and attach redacted sample finding to show format.

tara-legal: I'll review. Send draft by EOD today. Also we need to add a paragraph disclaiming we won't share raw PII and we redact findings.

jess-sales: Also pricing: mike, can you confirm the Dedicated bump if customer requests reserved scanning window? We need a concise line for the quote deck.

mike-ops: Short answer: scheduled scan reservation = +10% on committed GPU pool for the week of the test, or we can run during off-peak no-charge but with potential rate limits. I'll send the exact phrasing for the quote.

jess-sales: Great — plan: Sam drafts pen-test letter + red-team scope, Tara checks legal wording, Mike provides ops/price blurb and presign command, Alex gives the KMS attestation snippet. I'll bundle into a single PDF and send to Novus by Fri noon.

compliance-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 Type II cover page and ISO27001 statement of applicability excerpt if available. Link: https://intranet.redwood/compliance/proofpack-templates

jess-sales: Thanks — I'll ping again if anything slips. @sam-security @tara-legal @mike-ops @alex-cto please mark done when you've uploaded your snippets to the shared drive (Drive: /ProofPacks/novusbank-poc). :thumbsup:
